case_study_packaging.headline: Advantia Health unlocks $716K in annual EBITDA lift and 3.2× ROI within six-month strategic sourcing sprint
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: Rapid acquisition-driven growth left Advantia Health’s 25+ OB/GYN clinics buying independently, juggling duplicate suppliers, and paying above-market rates. With private-equity sponsor BlueMountain Capital targeting quick EBITDA expansion, Advantia needed an experienced partner to reveal hidden spend, renegotiate entrenched contracts, and install procurement discipline—fast.
approach_summary: Mapped & cleansed $19 M in spend data from two legacy AP systems, isolating $13.7 M addressable across direct and indirect categories.
Negotiated incumbent Athenahealth contract from 3.39 % to 3.15 %, avoiding a $9 M termination penalty while saving $259K annually.
Ran competitive RFP and distributor consolidation that shifted all sites to a single McKesson agreement, capturing $156K (14 %) medical-supply savings.
Implemented demand-management policy and enrolled clinics in Bayer’s Confidence-in-Coverage program, trimming $77K on IUD devices without changing vendors.
Designed and began rolling out an in-house sonography staffing model, projected to cut outsourced imaging spend by $152K (19 %).
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya delivered $716,394 in run-rate savings—59 % above the $450K minimum guarantee—across seven categories, generating a 3.2× return on the firm’s fixed fee of $225K. First dollars hit the P&L just 30 days after kickoff, and Treya’s work also standardized ordering practices, centralized distribution, and created a replicable sourcing playbook that continues to fuel post-project savings.
where_we_were_unique: Accelerated ‘quick-win’ tactics delivered tangible savings within the first month of engagement.
Deep healthcare supplier knowledge enabled a win–win Athena renegotiation despite a prohibitive $9 M termination clause.
Hands-on clinic engagement secured behavioral compliance (e.g., 5-unit IUD order policy) across decentralized locations.
Exceeded guaranteed savings by 59 % while simultaneously strengthening procurement processes for sustained value.

generation_notes: ROI calculated as $716K annual savings ÷ $225K fixed fee = 3.18, rounded to 3.2×.
